canonical_exact_policy: Maximize detection count, then minimize all-signature cost sum, then deterministic policy tie order
cap_scope: One problem/H0 solve across the entire integer budget grid; deterministic root order; caches released between roots
closure_informed_affordable: Restrict to currently affordable unqueried actions; use unchanged distinct-signature immediate-conflict count per cost, cost/ID ties, then constant-first and cheapest fallback within affordable actions
comparison_dominating_point: Among attainable frontier points with detection >= comparator and cost <= comparator, minimize cost, then maximize detection, then deterministic point encoding; retain weak equality and strict domination separately
exact_full_budget_endpoint: All new signatures detected; no forced exhaustive-original warrant count because detection-optimal E can stop without exhausting harmless queries
expected_schedule_basis: Counts computed solely from retained input histories, catalogues, and signature membership before any new evaluation policy outcomes; capped exact rows must remain explicit rather than change denominators.
failure_handling: Any capped root has unavailable exact frontiers for its whole grid; retain partial Bellman evidence, comparators, hindsight bounds, missing denominators and valid outputs; no truncation or cap increases
freeze_chronology: Known baseline reproduced before freeze; new E and D_affordable decisions restricted to four development problems and tiny correctness fixtures before freeze
frontier_ties: Prefer STOP, then smaller current action cost, then opaque action ID, then canonical child-choice encodings in fixed outcome order
hindsight_bound: Minimum contradictory acquired subset cost lower-bounds a detected path cost; affordable hindsight count upper-bounds prospective detection and is not an executable auditor
hindsight_ties: Minimum subset cost, then cardinality, then sorted opaque query IDs
integer_budget_grid: Every integer from zero through unqueried catalogue cost at the original paid stopping history, inclusive
legacy_chronology: Documented historical simulator defect remains unchanged and isolated; no imports or generation from that simulator
legacy_policy_semantics: Original A-D rule and unaffordable-next-action cutoff retained unchanged; no reranking or budget input to their selectors
objective: Deterministic attainable nondominated (detected distinct k2 signatures, sum of added actual retrieval cost across all compatible distinct k2 signatures)
primary_comparison: exact_frontier minus closure_informed_affordable at matched hard allowance, with separate realized spending and attained detection
prospective_information: Fixed nominal model and k2 envelope for D, D_affordable and E; available budget only for D_affordable and E; never actual k, realized signature, unqueried answers, actual omissions, truth, hindsight subset, or evaluator failure labels
resource_accounting: Per-root states, frontier sizes, child combinations, planner/checker CPU and wall time and process peak resource where practical; no new timing competition
root_grouping: Group identical ordered paid H0 within each problem; verify every compatible hypothetical signature follows that same retained deterministic path and stopping point
sampling_inference: None; no sampling intervals, significance claims, incident probabilities or deployment superiority
signature_weighting: Distinct observable cells of fixed k2 envelope have unit design weight; never parent/world multiplicity or a calibrated deployment prior
support_semantics: Unchanged all-compatible-world actual-k support at percentage anchors; alarm, same-proposal warrant restoration, withdrawal, pending uncertainty and archive irreducibility remain separate
